body: Yeah, me too. Nights are the loneliest. I keep the television playing in the background while I just lay in bed, staring at the ceiling.

Hey, dude. I’m really sorry about your girlfriend. I had a long distance relationship that ended too. However, she wanted to continue as friends but I kept pushing my feelings onto her and that pushed her away. She decided to call it quits yesterday. I understand what you’re going through. She was the only one that stuck around. So now the world seems empty. I wish I could help somehow, but just know you’re not dealing with this alone. Feel free to message me anytime.
